You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make nutella pancakes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a new non-stick spatula (45 minutes)
Step 2. Sift the all-purpose flour into a large bowl (3 minutes)
Step 3. Melt a tablespoon of butter in the microwave (30 seconds)
Step 4. Whisk the wet and dry ingredients together until smooth (2 minutes)
Step 5. Crack the eggs into a separate mixing cup (1 minute)
Step 6. Measure out the whole milk (1 minute)
Step 7. Find the clean mixing bowls in the pantry (2 minutes)
Step 8. Grease the griddle with a light coating of oil (1 minute)
Step 9. Take the jar of Nutella out of the cupboard (15 seconds)
Step 10. Set the table with plates and napkins (3 minutes)
Step 11. Rinse the mixing bowls to ensure they are dust-free (1 minute)
Step 12. Plug in the electric griddle (10 seconds)
Step 13. Combine the milk and eggs into the flour mixture (2 minutes)
Step 14. Check the expiration date on the baking powder (30 seconds)
Step 15. Stir the melted butter into the batter (45 seconds)
Step 16. Prepare a piping bag for the Nutella filling (5 minutes)
Step 17. Gather the salt and sugar from the spice rack (2 minutes)
Step 18. Measure out the vanilla extract (30 seconds)
Step 19. Add a drop of vanilla to the batter (10 seconds)
Step 20. Locate the vanilla extract in the refrigerator door (1 minute)
Step 21. Scoop Nutella into a small microwave-safe dish (1 minute)
Step 22. Flip the pancakes once bubbles form on the surface (2 minutes)
Step 23. Pour the batter onto the hot griddle (30 seconds)
Step 24. Warm the Nutella slightly to make it spreadable (20 seconds)
Step 25. Mix a pinch of salt and sugar into the dry flour (1 minute)
Step 26. Whisk in the baking powder (30 seconds)
Step 27. Spread a thin layer of Nutella onto a parchment sheet (10 minutes)
Step 28. Walk to the pantry to find the flour bag (1 minute)
Step 29. Check the grocery list for missing ingredients (5 minutes)
Step 30. Clean the whisk for the final mixing (2 minutes)
Step 31. Squeeze a swirl of Nutella onto the cooking pancake (1 minute)
Step 32. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 33. Clear the kitchen counter for workspace (10 minutes)
Step 34. Whisk the eggs until they are frothy (2 minutes)
Step 35. Prepare a warming plate in the oven (5 minutes)
Step 36. Open the bag of flour (15 seconds)
Step 37. Set out the serving spoons (30 seconds)
Step 38. Verify that the baking powder is active (2 minutes)
Step 39. Transfer the warmed Nutella into the piping bag (2 minutes)
Step 40. Pre-heat the griddle to medium heat (5 minutes)
